title: Realization of the coordinate-line augmentation
statement: Fix a finite purity datum P, a separated finite-type P.field.k-scheme T, an annihilating exponent r+1, a bounded-below pro-etale complex K and a constructible finite-Tor ordinary representative Ke with comparison isomorphism eK. In the source coordinates of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-source] and [def-pur-coordinate-line-adjunction-maps], the inverse fixed compact-support site comparison followed by compact-support image of sourceComparison.hom and the integration augmentation is the site comparison of the actual ordinary composite counit, preceded by compact-support image of sourceCoordinates.hom, followed by eK.hom. The retained ordinary source is bounded below by etaleSource_plus; every comparison is at the standard affine-line compactification.

source.place: First two sentences and final comparison paragraph, expanded coordinate-line calculation

proof.text: Expand the actual standard compactification comparison as exact open comparison and the specified proper direct-image counit mate. The compared open counit and the projective trace square identify the restricted integration trace. The fixed comparison agrees with this composite by expansion of its inclusion comparisons.

source.place: Ordinary affine-line composite adjunction and its final site-comparison paragraph

proof.text: Use projectionComparison_etaleOrigin (or its proved compact_projection_square component) to paste the proper tensor/exchange mate square with the open projection square and pullback-composition coherence. This identifies the two actual compact-support projections in the retained sourceComparison coordinates. Both projections are invertible on the constructible finite-Tor input. Invert the square and tensor the trace square; siteTensorUnitEvaluation gives the coefficient-unit evaluation compatibility; tensor symmetry and the canonical tensorators identify the final right unitors.

source.place: Ordinary affine-line composite adjunction and its final site-comparison paragraph

proof.text: The ordinary inverse-projection trace composite is the actual composite counit by the coordinate-line counit tensor lemma. Transport its source by sourceCoordinates and its representative by eK. Naturality yields the asserted augmentation equality. The argument retains the chosen bounded ordinary source throughout.

theorem coordinate_line_augmentation_realization
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (aT : T ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aT] [QuasiCompact aT] [IsSeparated aT] [IsNoetherian T]
    (r : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Ring P) = 0)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P))))
    (Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (Ring P) T)
    (hKe : Etale.DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P)) T Ke)
    (eK : (VectorIntegrationSite.comparison (Ring P) T).obj Ke ≅ K.obj) :
    (fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso (Ring P)
        (affineTraceLineCompactification T)).inv.app
      ⟨etaleSource P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1) T r hA Ke,
        etaleSource_plus P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1) T r hA Ke hKe⟩ ≫
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P))
      (affineTraceLineCompactification T)).map
        (sourceComparison P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1) T r hA
          K.obj Ke eK).hom ≫
    augmentation P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1) T r hA
      (primeUnit P T aT) P.field.k aT K.obj Ke hKe eK =
    (VectorIntegrationSite.comparison (Ring P) T).map
      ((Etale.affineTraceLineLeft (Ring P) T).map (sourceCoordinates P T r hA Ke).hom ≫
        (adjunction (Ring P) (P.coefficients.l ^ (r + 1)) hA T
          (pow_pos (Fact.out : P.coefficients.l.Prime).pos _)
          (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using (primeUnit P T aT).pow (r + 1))).counit.app Ke) ≫
      eK.hom
